title: Scyap's Fog Begone Mod
description: This mod adds a toggle button option to disable Minecraft's new fog render  in the "Video Settings" settings.
body:
![Fog Begone Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/464fcb46c16f521e1752216812255843902d10ce.png)
# Mod Information:
This mod adds a toggle button option in the "Video Settings" settings to disable Minecraft's new fog render (The one that makes everywhere look desaturated)

I don't like fog. It's hazy and desaturating and it gets everywhere.


# How to Use:

Go to "Options" > "Video Settings" > Scroll until you find the "Disable Fog" > Click it to enable or disable it

"Disable Fog" is ON by default (I mean that's why you downloaded this mod right...)

![Fog Begone Disabled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/386837cfc841d6c4a6167577d63330832bade9ef.png)
![Fog Begone Enabled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/24e7601b9210a47f07efb5c69d4c7bfec77a77b3.png)
